marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 20 knots diminishing to light this evening then
increasing to northeast 15 late overnight. Wind increasing to northwest 30 early
Wednesday morning then diminishing to northwest 20 early Wednesday
evening. Rain beginning this evening becoming snow or rain Wednesday
morning. Fog patches dissipating early Wednesday morning. Visibility 1 mile or
less in fog patches and as low as 1 mile in precipitation. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 late Wednesday
morning.<br/>
